caveats.text: Test splits are small (retrieval test: 21 items, 17 retrieval-eligible; Standard vs Research test: 34 pairs). Confidence intervals are wide; read point estimates with care.
The production default (hybrid without the reranker) was chosen after seeing v0 test results, so the v0 test split is no longer a clean holdout for that choice.
The citation verifier's holdout split was scored twice: at the end of development and again after safety fixes. No rule was tuned to holdout scores.
The research-summary ablation was not measured live; the summary hand-off is tested offline only.
Analytics routing generalised weakly: task-type accuracy was 36/36 on dev but 31/54 on the holdout split.

decisions.title: Hybrid retrieval (dense + lexical, RRF) is the production default
decisions.text: Production default: hybrid RRF without the reranker. On the retrieval-eligible test items, hybrid beats dense on hit@10 (+6 / -0, p = 0.031). On dev the difference is not distinguishable.

decisions.title: Cross-encoder reranker rejected on held-out data
decisions.text: Negative finding: the reranker looked better on dev (MRR), but on the held-out test split it lowered Recall@10 against hybrid. It stays experimental behind MS_RERANK_ENABLED; future reranker experiments need new dev questions and a newly frozen holdout.

definitions.label: Context recall (IDs, evidence pack)
definitions.what_it_measures: Share of distinct gold passage handles that appear in the evidence pack.

definitions.label: Context precision (IDs, evidence pack)
definitions.what_it_measures: Share of distinct evidence-pack handles that are gold handles. Undefined for an empty pack.

definitions.label: Context recall (IDs, cited passages)
definitions.what_it_measures: Share of distinct gold passage handles that the answer actually cites.

definitions.label: Context precision (IDs, cited passages)
definitions.what_it_measures: Share of distinct cited handles that are gold handles. Undefined when the answer cites nothing.

definitions.label: Context recall (text similarity, evidence pack)
definitions.what_it_measures: Share of gold passages whose best normalised string similarity to any pack passage exceeds 0.5. A lexical heuristic, not a judgement of meaning.

definitions.label: Context precision (text similarity, evidence pack)
definitions.what_it_measures: Rank-weighted average precision of pack passages, where a pack passage counts as relevant when its best string similarity to a gold passage is at least 0.5.

definitions.label: Faithfulness (model-judged)
definitions.what_it_measures: Share of the answer's claims that a judge model finds supported by the evidence pack.

definitions.label: Answer relevancy (model-judged)
definitions.what_it_measures: Mean embedding similarity between the question and questions a judge model generates from the answer; zero when the answer is non-committal.

definitions.label: Context precision vs reference (model-judged)
definitions.what_it_measures: Rank-weighted precision of pack passages judged useful for an authored reference answer.

definitions.label: Context recall vs reference (model-judged)
definitions.what_it_measures: Share of an authored reference answer's statements that a judge model attributes to the evidence pack.

definitions.label: Factual correctness vs reference (model-judged)
definitions.what_it_measures: Claim-level F1 between the answer and an authored reference answer, as judged by a model.

runs.title: RAGAS heuristics on grounded answers, live-v0
RAGAS heuristics on Standard vs Research, test

caveats.text: RAGAS scores are heuristics computed by the ragas library, not objective truth. ID-based scores depend on the gold handles being complete; text-similarity scores are lexical and can miss paraphrases or reward surface overlap.

RAGAS ID-based context recall counts every distinct gold handle, alternates included, so it reads lower than the historical Standard vs Research figure, which counts a gold fact as found when any of its accepted handles was retrieved. Recomputing the per-fact rule over the same items reproduces the historical figures exactly; the gap is definitional.

caveats.text: Model-judged metrics (faithfulness, answer relevancy) are wired but were not run: no model credits were available. Reference-answer metrics need authored reference answers; the gold sets hold short gold facts and handles, so they are not runnable yet.

Computed on persisted live outputs and the committed gold datasets: no new model calls, and nothing was tuned on these scores. The runs recorded the base commit while the working tree held uncommitted changes.
